title: Selective payment channel recovery
applicability: Synthetic Selective payment channel recovery product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
xp_c_channel_items exposes distinct original REJECTED, ACCEPTED and QUEUED states. cancel_channel_queue_item yields an explicit cancellation only for QUEUED items. send_channel_replacement creates an independent economic transfer and never cancels the original; abandon cancels the business obligation. refresh_channel_settlements imports accepted original settlements and, when the public batch recovery_available is true, queued settlements. Cancelled and rejected originals do not settle. Deliveries are independently observable per obligation. A batch-wide switch may duplicate accepted or uncancelled queued payments. Route fees are recorded on each delivery.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_channel_business_keys. manage_channel_business_key accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Retrieve each original instruction and stable supplier business key. Bind recovery to those keys, quarantine cancelled originals, and acknowledge one receipt per obligation. Assigning new business keys permits a duplicate that the bank cannot infer is the same commercial debt. retrieve_instruction_register publishes the original business keys. bind_business_keys uses the original instruction batch reference to preserve those keys; another reference creates new business keys, and replacement receipts will then carry those keys instead. set_cancelled_instruction_disposition chooses CANCELLED or QUEUED as the continuing commitment for cancelled originals. acknowledge_deliveries joins actual receipts by the bound keys: original invoices become PAID only when the key still matches; otherwise receipts remain UNALLOCATED_RECEIPT. Bank transaction completion alone cannot clear a different supplier invoice. Permitted actions: retrieve_instruction_register, bind_business_keys, set_cancelled_instruction_disposition, acknowledge_deliveries. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `cancel_channel_queue_item`

Cancel an original channel item only while it is QUEUED. A confirmed cancellation is recorded immediately. Already accepted/settled items cannot be recalled with queue cancellation.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `item_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `manage_channel_business_key`

Retrieve each original instruction and stable supplier business key. Bind recovery to those keys, quarantine cancelled originals, and acknowledge one receipt per obligation. Assigning new business keys permits a duplicate that the bank cannot infer is the same commercial debt. Actions: retrieve_instruction_register, bind_business_keys, set_cancelled_instruction_disposition, acknowledge_deliveries. reference identifies the public business reference or named party; amount_minor records the explicit amount involved. Read the product article for local dependencies.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `retrieve_instruction_register`, `bind_business_keys`, `set_cancelled_instruction_disposition`, `acknowledge_deliveries` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `reference` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `send_channel_replacement`

Create a new economic transfer through standard_fallback or express_fallback for one item. The bank permits a new transfer even if an original is accepted or queued; that original continues and can cause a duplicate. abandon cancels the business obligation without paying it.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `item_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `route` | string: `standard_fallback`, `express_fallback`, `abandon` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
